title: Even Odd Tree
statement:
A binary tree is even-odd when every even-indexed level contains odd values in strictly increasing left-to-right order, and every odd-indexed level contains even values in strictly decreasing left-to-right order. The root is at level 0. Return whether the tree is even-odd.

## Examples

```text
Input: root = [1, 10, 4, 3, null, 7, 9, 12, 8, 6, null, null, 2]
Output: true
```

```text
Input: root = [5, 4, 2, 3, 3, 7]
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- The tree has between 1 and 10^5 nodes.
- `1 <= Node.val <= 10^6`
